findings.note: All four are simply named puppet-construction types (co-hyponyms of 'puppet'), split across set-puppet-type and set-creature-form; a player could easily group them together as 'kinds of puppets' rather than seeing the intended type→example and creature→form mappings.

notes:
set-puppet-type and set-creature-form both surface bare puppet-construction terms (marionette, sock puppet, shadow puppet, hand puppet) as answer words, letting a solver cluster all four as 'kinds of puppets' instead of resolving the intended type→example and creature→form mappings.
- set-creature-form: shadow puppet and hand puppet are bare puppet-type nouns that match marionette/sock puppet in set-puppet-type, inviting a 'kinds of puppets' misgroup across the two sets.
  Try: Replace shadow puppet and hand puppet with phrases that don't read as puppet-type nouns, e.g. dragon : silk banner puppet and witch : broomstick prop puppet — reword so the form is described distinctly rather than named as a puppet category shared with set-puppet-type
  Or: Change the relationship grain entirely: pair each creature with a specific staging technique word (e.g. 'dragon : backlit silhouette', 'witch : glove animation') that isn't a puppet-type noun at all
  Or: If shadow puppet/hand puppet must stay, replace marionette and sock puppet in set-puppet-type instead (see that fix) so no two puppet-type nouns co-occur across sets
- set-puppet-type: marionette and sock puppet are the same class of bare puppet-type nouns as shadow puppet/hand puppet in set-creature-form, creating a cross-set 'puppet types' cluster that competes with the intended analogies.
  Try: Swap marionette/sock puppet for puppet-type terms that don't overlap with shadow/hand puppet categories, e.g. use 'rod puppet : Kermit' or 'finger puppet : Punch' so the puppet-type vocabulary in this set doesn't share a category axis with set-creature-form's forms
  Or: Keep marionette : Pinocchio but replace sock puppet : Lamb Chop with a different puppet-type/example pair whose type word is unrelated to shadow/hand distinctions (e.g. 'ventriloquist figure : Charlie McCarthy'), reducing the four-word overlap surface
  Or: Coordinate with the set-creature-form fix so between the two sets only one of the four appears as a bare 'puppet type' noun; convert the other set's terms to non-type phrasing
Do not change: set-object-feature, set-craft-tool — no allowlisted finding touches them.

message: the revision introduced word(s) outside the theme's world: "backlit silhouette" (Reads as a technical staging term rather than an object you'd find in a trunk, slightly breaking the concrete, tactile world.); "glove animation" (Same issue as backlit silhouette — a technique label, not a thing.)
